info.title: Fenergo Nebula Portal Tenant Command
info.description:
**Portal Tenant API**:
Portal Tenant API provides methods related to the Portal Users. It should be used to create, update and remove Portal Users. The Portal Tenant API can also be used to link or unlink Portal Users to legal entities, once a user is linked to an entity then can access it from the Fen-X Portal.
